scope.summary: Implement the vector 3D-and-materials live effects (V,T,G): Extrude & Bevel (depth/cap/bevel shape+width/rotation), Revolve (profile around vertical axis, angle/offset/cap), Inflate (puffed 3D volume), 3D Rotate (plane effect, no depth), Materials (parametric materials + custom graphics on 3D surfaces; community material assets provider-optional per group 16), 3D Lighting (multiple lights: intensity/rotation/height/softness/ambient/shadow), Ray-Traced Render (GPU ray-traced quality settings before export/expand), 3D (Classic) legacy engine (Opt). Geometric extrude/revolve/inflate primitives are native; materials/ray-trace GPU-required with real-GPU proof + headless fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Extrude & Bevel, Revolve, Inflate, 3D Rotate, Materials, 3D Lighting, Ray-Traced Render, 3D (Classic); GPU proof + headless; materials provider-optional
expected_tests: real-GPU: Extrude&Bevel/Revolve/Inflate/3D Rotate + Materials + 3D Lighting + Ray-Traced render
headless: EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE fallback; native extrude/revolve/inflate geometry without materials
test: community materials provider-optional (EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE when absent)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
